why: Codex overrides any key of its config for one run with -c key=value, and the sandbox key set to no sandbox is the same hole as the sandbox switch. The fail side starts Codex that way from a postinstall, the Nx shape. The pass side overrides the approval policy with its never value, which the Codex config reference recommends for non-interactive runs, so it is not counted. Whoever reads only switches passes the fail side; whoever counts every override fails the pass side.
